rows.note: Use 提供 as the all-purpose choice for making something available, especially money, information, or a service.

example.english: The company will supply you with enough information.
example.traditional: 公司會提供足夠資料畀你。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 wui5 tai4 gung1 zuk1 gau3 zi1 liu2 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use 供應 for an ongoing or organized supply of goods, fuel, or ammunition.

example.english: This company will supply fresh vegetables to nearby restaurants.
example.traditional: 呢間公司會供應新鮮蔬菜畀附近餐廳。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 wui5 gung1 jing3 san1 sin1 so1 coi3 bei2 fu6 gan6 caan1 teng1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday noun for supplies or provisions, especially material goods.

example.english: The relief supply for the disaster area is still insufficient.
example.jyutping: zoi1 keoi1 ge3 mat6 zi1 zung6 mei6 gau3

rows.note: Use this for supplies or stocks deliberately stored up for future use.

example.english: The company has enough supply stored up for a typhoon.
example.traditional: 公司有足夠嘅儲備應付打風。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 jau5 zuk1 gau3 ge3 cyu5 bei6 jing1 fu6 daa2 fung1

rows.note: Use this when the provisions specifically consist of food, especially stored food.

example.english: The villagers got through the hardest days on their food supply.
example.traditional: 村民靠糧食捱過最艱難嗰段日子。
example.jyutping: cyun1 man4 kaau3 loeng4 sik6 ngaai4 gwo3 zeoi3 gaan1 naan4 go2 dyun6 jat6 zi2

rows.note: Use this when you mean the quantity of something that is supplied or available.

example.english: The supply of this type of mask is very low right now.
example.traditional: 呢款口罩而家嘅供應量好少。
example.jyutping: nei1 fun2 hau2 zaau3 ji4 gaa1 ge3 gung1 jing3 loeng6 hou2 siu2

rows.note: Use 補充 when replenishing something so that it remains full or adequate.

example.english: The water is all gone, so we need to supply more before there is enough.
example.traditional: 啲水飲晒喇，要補充返先夠用。
example.jyutping: di1 seoi2 jam2 saai3 laa3 jiu3 bou2 cung1 faan1 sin1 gau3 jung6

rows.note: Use 配備 specifically when equipping a person, vehicle, or place with equipment.

example.english: The manufacturer will supply every car with a reversing camera.
example.traditional: 車廠會配備每架車一個倒車鏡頭。
example.jyutping: ce1 cong2 wui5 pui3 bei6 mui5 gaa3 ce1 jat1 go3 dou2 ce1 geng2 tau4
